Synopsis:
Gale is a Companion.This dialogue can trigger as COM (if the players approach Elminster with Gale as a companion), as a regular dialogue (if the players approach Elminster while Companion Gale is in the camp) or a CFM (if the player skips Elminster altogether).It can trigger in either Creche or SCL.

Cluster Contexts:
- GLO_Elminster_CFM_GaleCom.json: The player and Gale are already known to each other — this scene can occur if Gale is travelling with you, left in camp, or if you skipped meeting Elminster (the exchange can play as a companion, camp, or cutscene/flash‑memory event, and can trigger in either the Creche or SCL). Off‑screen, Gale carries a Netherese orb embedded in his chest that has made him dangerously volatile and tied him to events with the Absolute; Mystra previously turned away from him but now seeks to give him a chance at redemption. Elminster (posing as a weary traveller in these lines) arrives as Mystra’s messenger to explain that Mystra has the power to pause the orb’s progression and intends for Gale to be used as the catalyst to destroy the Heart of the Absolute. Other camp NPCs (Shadowheart, Halsin, Withers/Jergal, etc.) may be nearby with their own business, but they are not central to this specific charge.
- GLO_Elminster_OM_Gale_COM.json: COM when the players approach Elminster with Gale, or dialogue that triggers if Gale is in camp when Elminster is approached by an Avatar.Elminster does a brief introduction before joining the camp, potentially taking the players along.Can trigger in either Creche or SCL.
- LOW_Elminster_OM_Gale_AOM_OOM.json: Elminster greets Gale after he's completed Sorcerous Sundries and learned how to reforge the Crown of Karsus, either outside the shop, or in camp. Elminster tells Gale that Mystra requires him to come speak with her in teh Stormshore Tabernacle, where he will learn the truth about the orb.
- LOW_Elminster_OM_Gale_COM.json: Elminster standing on a balcony attached to Sharess caress in Wyrm's crossing, looking outward. He's here to decry Gale on Mystra's behalf - Gale had a chance to sacrifice himself and destroy the Absolute previously, but hesitated. Now Elminster is here to relay the consequencs to him.
- GLO_Elminster_OM_Gale_AOM_OOM.json: AOM or OOM that triggers when talking to Elminster.Elminster does a brief introduction before joining the camp, potentially taking the players along.Can trigger in either Creche or SCL.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Weary Traveller: Ah! There you are. I hope you don't mind my having ingratiated myself into the most palatable graces of your provisions. You find me quite sated indeed. (node 28)
- Weary Traveller: Mmm, yes, what a delightful wedge of Old Elturian that was. Doesn't do to parley on an empty stomach, you know. Makes one's words frivolous when they should be grave. (node 0)
- Weary Traveller: Plenty to digest, after all. A good deal to stew over, if you will. Words ladled with import should be savoured so as to better absorb their meaning, wouldn't you agree? (node 76)
- Gale: Elminster. (node 105)
- Weary Traveller: Right. Ahem. You see... (node 9)
- Weary Traveller: I, er... ahem. That is to say... (node 87)
- Weary Traveller: Gale, m'boy, I've come to address a most pressing matter. I'll speak as plainly as I can, forswearing the accustomed frills that decorate my speech. (node 10)
- Weary Traveller: I'm here on behalf of Mystra. The message and the charge I bring you are hers. (node 91)
- Player: You were sent here as an actual divine messenger? (node 22)
- Gale: Mystra's delicate feet are ill-suited for the hardships of the road. (node 109)
- Gale: I could debate you on that. (node 97)
- Weary Traveller: You know where you went wrong, Gale, and I trust you've told your fellow traveller here the nature of your ills. (node 48)
- Gale: I can't say that so far I've volunteered the entire truth. (node 16)
- Weary Traveller: Do you mean to say you never bothered to disclose how dangerous you are? (node 84)
- Gale: Not in so many words, no. (node 81)
- Weary Traveller: Then you two have much to discuss after I'll have taken my leave. (node 50)
- Weary Traveller: In short, Gale - through his own doing - has become a living explosive that could wipe from this world this very gathering, and much more besides. (node 29)
- Weary Traveller: For his folly, Mystra forsook him, but now she has decreed he is to be given a chance of redemption. (node 40)
- Gale: Mystra would consider... forgiveness? (node 5)
- Weary Traveller: She would consider what she considers to be forgiveness. (node 45)
- Weary Traveller: Mystra is aware of the misadventures that have befallen you both. She knows of your strife with the Absolute, that most insidious of evils. (node 24)
- Player: It sounds like the most insidious of evils was actually Gale all along. (node 66)
- Gale: By circumstance, but not by purpose, I swear. I never intended you any harm. (node 83)
- Weary Traveller: His acts were misguided, yes, but I assure you that deep down he has a heart of - let's say at least silver. Which is more than can be said for the foe you face. (node 19)
- Weary Traveller: You must know that the Absolute is more dangerous than you can possibly conceive. It threatens all who live - even those who are undying. It threatens the gods, the Weave, the very fabric of the universe itself. (node 27)
- Weary Traveller: That is why I have come here to charge you, Gale, with its destruction. It is Mystra's belief that only you can. (node 65)
- Player: Gale alone? How so? (node 82)
- Gale: The orb. (node 12)
- Weary Traveller: Precisely. (node 6)
- Weary Traveller: That which renders him so dangerous is an orb of Netherese origin that is buried within his chest. And that, Gale, is how we arrive at the heart of my directive. (node 86)
- Weary Traveller: Mystra has granted me the power to stop the clock, as it were, on the orb's rush to overpower you. Instead, you will be able to unleash its lethal combustion at will. (node 100)
- GROUP_Daisy: Interesting. This could be help or hindrance - we shall have to see. (node 88)
- Weary Traveller: You must find the Heart of the Absolute, whatever that may be, and use yourself as the catalyst that will burn it from this world. (node 23)
- Player: We'll be rid of both the Absolute and Gale in one fell swoop. Win-win. (node 42)

context: Gale is a Companion who secretly bears a Netherese orb embedded in his chest that has made him dangerously volatile and tied him to the Absolute; Mystra once turned away from him but now intends to give him a chance at redemption. Elminster is present posing as a weary traveller and acting as Mystra’s messenger: he explains that Mystra can pause the orb’s progression and wants Gale to be the catalyst to destroy the Heart of the Absolute by unleashing the orb’s power. This exchange can play as a companion approach, a camp conversation, or a cutscene/flash event (Creche or SCL), and other camp NPCs may be nearby but are not central to the charge. The conversation is informed by prior events in which Gale previously hesitated at an opportunity to sacrifice himself against the Absolute, which adds urgency and reproach to Elminster’s message.
